descriptions.w3d_d25g_body_bounce_8004ce58: Bounce response: marks the body bounced, flips and damps its velocity by 0.4, and when the speed falls under 0.02 stops it, settles it at the rest position raised by +64 if it was rolling, and releases the trail; otherwise clears the moving flags and, when audio exists, moves the sound and sets its volume to min((speed-0.02)/0.02, 1) before updating it.
